shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat index.html && cat src/main.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"interface ConfigProviderProps|const ConfigProvider|function ConfigProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && rg \"type Lang|type MobileOS\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/import \\{ useMemo, useState \\} from 'react';/import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';/\" src/App.tsx
perl -0pi -e \"s/  const text = useMemo\\(\\(\\) => translations\\[language\\], \\[language\\]\\);\\n/  const text = useMemo(() => translations[language], [language]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() => {\\n    document.documentElement.lang = language;\\n  }, [language]);\\n/\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,80p' && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx"
